rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded blastocyst with thinned zona and acknowledges limited single-image assessment; comments on ICM and TE are generally consistent, though somewhat cautious and not highly specific to visible features.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve, male factor, endometrium, prior failed cycles, and semen motility with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, especially in downgrading prognosis due to repeated prior failures; minor issue is some speculative discussion beyond the provided data.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including SET preference and cautious use of add-ons; slight overreach in suggesting some tests/interventions without stronger indication.
Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning after failure, including uterine cavity review, sperm assessment, and selective further workup.
